entries.e72ae7e586a918fa: Headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, the company forms a group with 2 consolidated subsidiaries (Takuto Shisutemu Inc. and Hoken Suteshon Inc.). It operates 3 businesses: telecommunications services, electricity and city gas retail, and consulting. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,973 million, and the company had 197 employees. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.f649c41c56dfb898: This business provides information and communications services in general and sells information and communications equipment, including the corporate VoIP service "Smart Hikari," the FMC service "Dokodemo Hon" that uses smartphones, the optical line service "iSmart Hikari," and the consumer internet connection service "iSmart Setsuzoku-F Hikari." The company owns only part of its communications facilities, and provides communications services that use facilities it does not own by procuring them from telecommunications carriers and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,377 million.
